root_causes.title: Missing single active-run gate
root_causes.summary: Starter allows multiple non-terminal runs on one workspace.
manifestations: POST second plan while first is planned returns 201
Two queued/running/planned rows coexist
UI can queue overlapping runs
Delete-while-active checks see wrong active count only if gate fixed first

root_causes.title: Apply/destroy skip lock requirement
root_causes.summary: Mutating terraform commands proceed without exclusive lock.
manifestations: POST apply unlocked returns 201
POST destroy unlocked returns 201
Shim executes apply without lock.acquire audit pairing
Operators can race applies across holders

root_causes.title: Lock unlock ignores holder
root_causes.summary: Any holder string unlocks the workspace.
manifestations: Unlock as bob while alice holds returns 204
Workspace locked flips false for non-holder
Stolen unlock enables unauthorized apply
lock.release audit (once restored) attributes wrong actor path

root_causes.title: Workspace delete ignores busy state
root_causes.summary: Delete succeeds while locked or while non-terminal runs exist.
manifestations: DELETE locked workspace returns 204
DELETE with planned run returns 204
Orphaned shim workdirs remain after premature delete
Lock row cascade-deleted mid-apply

root_causes.title: Invalid discard/cancel transitions accepted
manifestations: Discard applied run returns 200 discarded
Cancel planned run returns 200 canceled
Terminal runs reopen into discarded/canceled incorrectly
Audit status chains show impossible edges once audit works
